title: His Washing Machine Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo's washing machine ate one sock. Most people would buy new socks. Marlo built a business instead.

Watch how one lost sock turned into a million-dollar idea, what went wrong on day one, and the twist that beat a giant company.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).

#businessideas #entrepreneur #shorts
